PDFAction.doc: An action that is performed when, for example, a PDF annotation is activated or an outline item is clicked.

PDFActionGoTo.doc: PDFActionGoTo, a subclass of PDFAction, defines methods for getting and setting the destination of a go-to action.

PDFActionNamed.doc: PDFActionNamed defines methods used to work with actions in PDF documents, some of which are named in the Adobe PDF Specification.

PDFActionRemoteGoTo.doc: PDFActionRemoteGoTo, a subclass of PDFAction, defines methods for getting and setting the destination of a go-to action that targets another document.

PDFActionResetForm.doc: PDFActionResetForm, a subclass of PDFAction, defines methods for getting and clearing fields in a PDF form.

PDFActionURL.doc: PDFActionURL, a subclass of PDFAction, defines methods for getting and setting the URL associated with a URL action.

PDFAnnotation.doc: An annotation in a PDF document.

PDFAnnotationButtonWidget.doc: A PDFAnnotationButtonWidget object provides user interactivity on a page of a PDF document. There are three types of buttons available: push button, radio button, and checkbox.

PDFAnnotationChoiceWidget.doc: A PDFAnnotationChoiceWidget object provides user interactivity on a page of a PDF document, in the form of pop-up menus and lists.

PDFAnnotationFreeText.doc: A PDFAnnotationFreeText object displays text on a page.

PDFAnnotationLine.doc: A PDFAnnotationLine object displays a single line on a page.

PDFAnnotationMarkup.doc: A PDFAnnotationMarkup object appears as highlighting, underlining, or a strikethrough style applied to the text of a document.

PDFAnnotationPopup.doc: A PDFAnnotationPopup object provides user interactivity on a PDF page in the form of a pop-up menu.

PDFAnnotationSquare.doc: A rectangle annotation on a page.

PDFAnnotationStamp.doc: A PDFAnnotationStamp object allows you to display a word or phrase, such as “Confidential,” in a PDF page.

PDFAnnotationText.doc: A PDFAnnotationText object displays as an icon (such as a “sticky note”) attached to a specified point in the PDF document.

PDFAnnotationTextWidget.doc: A PDFAnnotationTextWidget object allows you to manage the appearance and content of text fields.

PDFAppearanceCharacteristics.doc: An object that represents appearance characteristics of a widget annotation.

PDFBorder.doc: An optional border for an annotation that lies completely within the annotation rectangle.

PDFDestination.doc: A PDFDestination object describes a point on a PDF page.

PDFDocument.doc: An object that represents PDF data or a PDF file and defines methods for writing, searching, and selecting PDF data.

PDFOutline.doc: A PDFOutline object is an element in a tree-structured hierarchy that can represent the structure of a PDF document.

PDFPage.doc: PDFPage, a subclass of NSObject, defines methods used to render PDF pages and work with annotations, text, and selections.

PDFSelection.doc: A PDFSelection object identifies a contiguous or noncontiguous selection of text in a PDF document.

PDFThumbnailView.doc: An object that contains a set of thumbnails, each of which represents a page in a PDF document.

PDFView.doc: An object that encapsulates the functionality of PDF Kit into a single widget that you can add to your application using Interface Builder.

PDFDocumentDelegate.doc: The delegate for the PDFDocument object.

PDFViewDelegate.doc: The delegate for the PDFView object.

PDFAreaOfInterest.doc: The mouse position over PDF view areas.

kPDFAnnotationArea.doc: The mouse is over an annotation.

kPDFControlArea.doc: The mouse is over a control.

kPDFIconArea.doc: The mouse is over an icon.

kPDFImageArea.doc: The mouse is over an image.

kPDFLinkArea.doc: The mouse is over a link.

kPDFNoArea.doc: The mouse is over an undefined area.

kPDFPageArea.doc: The mouse is over a page.

kPDFPopupArea.doc: The mouse is over a popup menu.

kPDFTextFieldArea.doc: The mouse is over a text field.

PDFBorderStyle.doc: PDF Kit annotation borders may have the following styles.

PDFDisplayBox.doc: The following box types may be used with PDFPage drawing and bounds-setting methods. See the Adobe PDF Specification for more information on box types, units, and coordinate systems.

kPDFDisplayBoxArtBox.doc: A rectangle defining the boundaries of the page’s meaningful content including surrounding white space intended for display. Default value equal to kPDFDisplayBoxCropBox.

kPDFDisplayBoxBleedBox.doc: A rectangle defining the boundaries of the clip region for the page contents in a production environment. Default value equal to kPDFDisplayBoxCropBox.

kPDFDisplayBoxCropBox.doc: A rectangle defining the boundaries of the visible region , expressed in default user-space units. Default value equal to kPDFDisplayBoxMediaBox.

kPDFDisplayBoxMediaBox.doc: A rectangle defining the boundaries of the physical medium for display or printing, expressed in default user-space units.

kPDFDisplayBoxTrimBox.doc: A rectangle defining the intended boundaries of the finished page. Default value equal to kPDFDisplayBoxCropBox.

PDFDisplayMode.doc: A wrapper for the chosen display mode constant.

kPDFDisplaySinglePage.doc: A display mode where the document displays one page at a time horizontally and vertically.

kPDFDisplaySinglePageContinuous.doc: A display mode where the document displays in continuous mode vertically, with single-page width horizontally.

kPDFDisplayTwoUp.doc: A display mode where the document displays two pages side-by-side.

kPDFDisplayTwoUpContinuous.doc: A display mode where the document displays in continuous mode vertically and displays two pages side-by-side horizontally.

PDFDocumentPermissions.doc: An enumeration that specifies document permissions status.

kPDFDocumentPermissionsNone.doc: The status that indicates no document permissions.

kPDFDocumentPermissionsOwner.doc: The status that indicates owner document permissions.

kPDFDocumentPermissionsUser.doc: The status that indicates user document permissions.

PDFInterpolationQuality.doc: A wrapper for the specified interpolation quality.

kPDFInterpolationQualityHigh.doc: The case specifying high interpolation quality.

kPDFInterpolationQualityLow.doc: The case specifying low interpolation quality.

kPDFInterpolationQualityNone.doc: The case where no interpolation quality is specified.

PDFLineStyle.doc: The following constants specify the available line ending styles.

kPDFLineStyleCircle.doc: A circular line ending filled with the annotation’s interior color, if any.

kPDFLineStyleClosedArrow.doc: A closed arrowhead line ending, consisting of a triangle with the acute vertex at the line end and filled with the annotation’s interior color, if any.

kPDFLineStyleDiamond.doc: A diamond-shaped line ending filled with the annotation’s interior color, if any.

kPDFLineStyleOpenArrow.doc: An open arrowhead line ending, composed from two short lines meeting in an acute angle at the line end.

kPDFLineStyleSquare.doc: A square line ending filled with the annotation’s interior color, if any.

PDFMarkupType.doc: The styles available for markup annotations in PDFKit.

PDFPrintScalingMode.doc: The type of scaling to be used when printing a page (see PDFDocument).

kPDFPrintPageScaleDownToFit.doc: Scale large pages down to fit the paper size (smaller pages do not get scaled up).

kPDFPrintPageScaleNone.doc: Do not apply scaling to the page when printing.

kPDFPrintPageScaleToFit.doc: Scale each page up or down to best fit the paper size.

PDFTextAnnotationIconType.doc: The types of icons that a text annotation can use.

PDFWidgetCellState.doc: The state of a button annotation, either on, off, or mixed.

kPDFWidgetMixedState.doc: The button widget is in a mixed state, neither on nor off.

kPDFWidgetOffState.doc: The button widget is in an unselected state.

kPDFWidgetOnState.doc: The button widget is in a selected state.

A URL for a link annotation.

action.doc: An object that represents an action for a PDF element, such as a link annotation.

alignment.doc: The alignment of the free text and text widget annotation’s text content.

allowsToggleToOff.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether clicking or tapping a selected radio button toggles it to an unselected state.

annotationKeyValues.doc: A dictionary that contains a deep copy of the widget’s properties.

backgroundColor.doc: The color of the widget’s background.

border.doc: Sets the border style for the annotation.

bounds.doc: Returns the bounding box for the annotation in page space.

buttonWidgetState.doc: The current state of the button widget annotation.

buttonWidgetStateString.doc: A string value that differentiates button widgets in the same group, such as to identify mutually exclusive radio buttons from each other.

caption.doc: The title of push button widget annotations.

choices.doc: An array of strings that specifies the options in either a list or a pop-up menu.

color.doc: Sets the stroke color for the annotation.

comb.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the annotation divides the text widget’s bounds into equally spaced segments, such as in a form entry field.

contents.doc: Returns the textual content (if any) associated with the annotation.

destination.doc: The destination for a link annotation.

endLineStyle.doc: The style of the line annotation’s ending point, such as square or filled arrowhead.

endPoint.doc: The point where a line ends, in annotation-space coordinates.

fieldName.doc: The widget identifier for form annotation actions and behaviors.

font.doc: The font the annotation uses to display text.

fontColor.doc: The font color the annotation uses to display text.

hasAppearanceStream.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the annotation has an appearance stream associated with it.

highlighted.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the annotation is in a highlighted state, such as when the mouse is down on a link annotation.

iconType.doc: The type of icon to display for a pop-up text annotation.

interiorColor.doc: The fill color for drawing a circle, line, or square annotation.

isPasswordField.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the text widget annotation displays a password field using bullet characters.

listChoice.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the choice widget annotation is a list or a pop-up menu.

markupType.doc: The markup type that the annotation displays, either highlight, strikethrough, underline, or redact.

maximumLength.doc: The maximum number of characters the text widget annotation allows.

modificationDate.doc: Returns the modification date of the annotation.

multiline.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the text widget annotation displays multiple lines.

open.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the pop-up annotation is in an opened state, displaying its text content, or in a closed state, displaying an icon.

page.doc: Returns the page that the annotation is associated with.

paths.doc: An array of bezier paths, in annotation-space coordinates, that compose the annotation.

popup.doc: Returns the pop-up annotation associated with an annotation.

quadrilateralPoints.doc: An array of values that represents the points bounding the marked-up text.

radiosInUnison.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether radio buttons in a group turn on and off in unison.

readOnly.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the widget is editable.

shouldDisplay.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the annotation should be displayed.

shouldPrint.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the annotation should appear when the document is printed.
